build_contract_from_dict: use contract_dict to instantiate a contract class by key such as mipnerf or donerf
create_MIPNeRFContract: create a MIPNeRFContract instance with config to contract 3D points into a bounded space
create_DoNeRFContract: create a DoNeRFContract instance with config to apply power-based distance contraction
contract_points_BBoxContract: contract 3D points into a normalized bounding box using BBoxContract contract_points method
inverse_contract_distance_MIPNeRFContrac: invert contracted distance values back to original scale using MIPNeRFContract inverse_contract_distance
